title: Nonlinear two-photon interaction of radiators with broadband squeezed vacuum

event.name: Third tohwa university international conference on statistical physics

title: Effect of a broadband squeezed vacuum on two-atom spontaneous emission
Successive photon emission from a two-level atom in a broadband squeezed vacuum

items.abstract: <jats:p>We characterize broadband parametric down conversion at low and high gain regimes. Two-photon absorption is measured at high gain, and sum-frequency generation is used to investigate the transition to high gain, and spectrally resolve two-photon interactions.</jats:p>
title: The Transition from Linear to Quadratic Flux Scaling in Nonlinear Optical Processes with Variable Brightness Broadband Squeezed Vacuum
Coherently driven two-level atom coupled to a broadband squeezed vacuum
Photon Statistics of Broadband Squeezed Vacuum
